I just got a note from a common friend, Paul, and I think that I will forego the glory of the PR in favor of this getting fixed in a timely manner :) It will take a very long time for my legal to sign off on contributions and I would rather this got fixed rather than languish.

Thank you for offering to fix this, I will take you up on your offer!

repository.name: netty
repository.description: Netty project - an event-driven asynchronous network application framework

issue.body:
…tBuffer(...)

Motivation:

When UNSAFE.allocateMemory is returning an address whose high bit is set we currently throw an IllegalArgumentException. This is not correct as it may return a negative number on at least sparc.

Modifications:

- Allow to pass in negative memoryAddress
- Add unit tests

Result:

Correctly validate the memoryAddress and so also work on sparc as expected. Fixes [#6574].
